newsitem.title: USA: Egghead Aug same-store sales down 34 pct.
newsitem.headline: Egghead Aug same-store sales down 34 pct.

text.p: Egghead Inc Friday reported that its same-store sales for August had fallen 34 percent from the year-ago figure.
The company said excluding sales of Microsoft Corp's Windows 95, released in August of 1995, August same-store sales were 24 percent lower than the year-ago figure.
The company said consolidated revenue from continuing operations for August was $24.1 million, a 31 percent decrease from $34.9 million a year before.
